name: Database Reader
description: Reads one table or the result of a read-only query from an external database into the session. DuckDB files are attached natively; SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL need the matching DuckDB extension (sqlite_scanner, postgres_scanner, mysql_scanner), installed once with make extensions. The attachment is read-only by default and detached after the copy; credentials are never saved to workflow.json and are masked in errors.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: Database family: duckdb and sqlite read a file from 'path', postgres and mysql connect through 'url'.

path.title: Database file
path.description: Absolute path to the .duckdb or .db file; used by the duckdb and sqlite drivers.

url.title: Connection URL
url.description: Connection string for the postgres and mysql drivers, e.g. postgresql://host:5432/db; user and password may be separate settings.

table.title: Table
table.description: Table to read, optionally schema-qualified (schema.table). Exactly one of table or query is required.

query.title: Query
query.description: Read-only SELECT/WITH query over the tables of the external database (bare table names work). Exactly one of table or query is required.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Attach the external database read-only; disable only when the source must be writable.

user.title: User
user.description: Database user for the postgres and mysql drivers; never persisted in workflow.json.

password.title: Password
password.description: Database password for the postgres and mysql drivers; never persisted in workflow.json and masked in error messages.
